training.metric_warning: These are Metarank's internal metrics on an 18-session smoke-test split. Source NDCG was already 1.0, so they do not establish improvement over FlowLens baselines.

limitations: The 200-group smoke-test import does not contain metadata for every validation candidate.
Rank responses prove runtime compatibility and candidate conservation only.
Gate C must hydrate candidate metadata and recompute FlowLens metrics on the unified evaluation population before any model comparison.
claim_boundary: This run proves a reproducible FlowLens-to-Metarank import, train, serve, and rank path. It does not prove ranking improvement, online causal lift, or business impact.
